343308.「風の神エルドナよ。悪しき風をはらい\n この地に 清き息吹を もたらしたまえ。:
O Eldona, Goddess of Wind, drive away the evil
winds and bring a pure breath to this land.

343311.「どんなに 時が経とうとも\n 我が弟子を 忘れるはずがない。:
No matter how much time passes, I will never
forget my disciple.

343312.「お懐かしゅうございます 師父。\n この地のケガレを はらい清めてくださり\n:
It brings back fond memories, Master. Thank
you for purifying this place of its
impurities.

343313.「……<pc>。およそ６０００年前\n この地には サワナギという名の\n 小国:
...<pc>. Some 6,000 years ago, the
small kingdom of Sawanagi thrived in this
land.

343314.「しかし ある時 災厄の王の出現とともに\n マガツカゼが吹き荒れ 一夜のうちに:
However, one day, with the appearance of the
King of Calamity, the Magatsukaze raged, and
the land was destroyed overnight.

343315.「マガツカゼは 人々の命と絶望を食いつくし\n やがて 醜悪な魔物を生んだ……。:
The Winds of Malice devoured people's lives
and despair, eventually giving birth to a
hideous monster. This is The Winds of Dread.

343316.「師父は 王国の生き残りを 弟子にとり\n ストームカイザーとして 鍛えてくださ:
My master took the kingdom's sole survivor as
his disciple and trained him to become Storm
Kaiser.

343317.「私たちは 師父と共に 途方もない苦労を重ね\n ついに マガツタタリカゼを\n:
Together with our Master, we endured immense hardships and finally succeeded in sealing *The Winds of Dread* at the bottom of the
valley.

343318.「今の世があるのは 師父のおかげなのです。\n 感謝しても しきれませぬ……。:
We owe the world's very existence to the
Master. Our gratitude knows no bounds.

343319.「……だが あれから幾星霜を重ね\n マガツタタリカゼの封印は 少しずつ\n 弱:
...But as the years have passed, the seal on
The Winds of Dread has gradually begun to
weaken.

343320.「あの時 多くの犠牲を出したというのに。\n ……アシノヤ。おまえも そのひとり:
So many lives were lost back then...
Ashinoya... Yours was among them.

343321.「あなたの弟子となって 後悔している者など\n ひとりもおりません。わたしたちは:
Not a single one of us who became your
disciple has ever regretted it. We all looked
up to you.

343322.「そして……救ってさしあげたかった……。: And... I wanted to save him.

343323.「……あなたならば いつかきっと\n マガツタタリカゼを 倒すことができる。:
...If it's you, I'm sure you'll defeat the
Winds of Dread someday.

343325.「かげろうに 溶けて風なる 君の声……。:
Your voice, melting into a mirage and becoming
the wind.

343326.「私には エルドナ神に託された チカラがある。\n ケガレを断ち切り 封じること:
I possess the power entrusted to me by Eldona.
I can sever and seal away impurity. I can also
purify the earth and cast protective barriers.

343327.「そうして 師父を名乗ってこそいるが\n 弟子たちがいなければ 何もできなかった:
Though I go by the title of "Master," I
couldn't have achieved anything without my
disciples.

343329.「この地のケガレは はらい清められた。\n 役目を果たしてくれた ごほうびを渡す:
The impurity in this place has been purified. I'll give you a reward for fulfilling your duty. Let's return to the hermitage
.
